gist.headline: A studio blooms in the hive
gist.blurb: Atelier has joined the image garden: a bilingual little studio for prompting, browsing the live model catalog, and nudging pixels around with reference images. English and 简体中文 now share an easel.
gist.summary: Added Atelier — Pollinations Image Studio, a bilingual English/简体中文 app built on the Pollinations image API with live model selection and reference-image editing.
gist.impact: People can use Atelier at image.xt1171.eu.org to generate images from prompts, choose from the current model catalog, and refine results with reference images in either supported language.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Atelier as a cozy shared digital art studio: a retro terminal and easel show prompt-generated pastel artwork, with two small pixel labels for “EN” and “中文” and framed reference images ready for editing. Polli, wearing a painter’s beret, warmly helps arrange blooming code-flowers and image frames, making the studio feel like a community-made creative workspace.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Atelier, a tiny bilingual digital image studio with a retro CRT art terminal, an easel showing a prompt-generated pastel landscape, pixel labels “EN” and “中文,” and a wall of framed reference images for editing; code-flowers bloom from lime green (#ecf874) pots around the desk. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny painter’s beret and gently hangs a reference frame beside the glowing screen. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
